content.hypothesis: One validation-fitted median residual offset improves untouched holdout MAE by >=0.05 rings over the qualified fixed HGB.
content.calibration: median(y_validation - prediction_hgb_seed_11); use all original validation rows, no trimming, rescaling or tuning
controls: Same HGB training and fixed baseline recipe
All previously scored validation rows; not fresh confirmatory data
No model retraining, alternative candidates or parameter rescue
No final holdout inference or scoring during screening
content.uncertainty_limit: Prospective interval is conditional on fixed training data and unverified row independence. Screening uses a deterministic bound, not statistical confirmation.

screening_rules.abs_delta_below_minimum_effect: REJECTED/NOT_RUN; universal MAE gain upper bound is abs(delta)
